Class Task

java.lang.Object
org.example.Task
public class Task extends Object
The Task class represents an individual task in the simulation. It decouples the operation being executed from the Item itself, allowing for better management of the queue of operations, potentially with different priorities. Each operation on an Item becomes its own "task" in the simulation queue.

  • Constructor Details

    • Task

      public Task(Item item, String operation)
      Constructor to initialize a Task with the associated Item, operation, and priority level. The priority is determined based on the priority of the Item: - HIGH priority corresponds to 3 - NORMAL priority corresponds to 2 - LOW priority corresponds to 1
      Parameters:
      item - the Item associated with the task
      operation - the name of the operation to be performed
